_comment: CPU-budget calibration workloads on the reference machine (Apple M2 Max, Release, idle, 2026-11-03/04): mm_render --bench <workload> --instances 100 --seconds 3, the minimum of 3 runs. Fixed, non-product workloads of the plugins' shape in the hosted process, 100 instances with their own buffers: the compute-bound 4x oversampled tanh (runs 0.3642 / 0.3650 / 0.3672), the SVF filter (0.1154 / 0.1155 / 0.1158) and the dynamics core: detector, envelope and gain computer (0.1142 / 0.1142 / 0.1161). CI runners measure the same and scale the budget limits by max(1, worst measured / reference): the two light workloads were added in M5 after hosted macOS runs read the tanh calibration 6 % fast while the lightest plugins (de-esser, Utility) read 20-28 % slow.
